description: Source code for synthesizing magic methods for JIT-compiled dataclasses in PyTorch, including functions to generate __init__, __repr__, __hash__, and comparison methods, with external dependencies on torch._jit_internal and torch._sources.

methods.name: _get_fake_filename
methods.description: Generates a fake filename for a class method based on a prefix, class name, and method name.

methods.name: compose_fn
methods.description: Creates a ParsedDef object representing a synthesized function with given body lines and signature.

methods.name: synthesize__init__
methods.description: Synthesizes the __init__ method for a dataclass, handling InitVar annotations and post-init calls.

methods.name: synthesize__repr__
methods.description: Synthesizes the __repr__ method for a dataclass, returning a string representation.

methods.name: synthesize__hash__
methods.description: Synthesizes the __hash__ method for a dataclass, currently raising NotImplementedError.

methods.name: synthesize_equality
methods.description: Synthesizes __eq__ and __ne__ comparison methods for a dataclass.

methods.name: synthesize_inequality
methods.description: Synthesizes inequality comparison methods (__lt__, __le__, __gt__, __ge__) for a dataclass.

methods.name: synthesize_comparison
methods.description: Helper function to generate comparison methods based on dataclass fields.
